one_line_description: Help Scout is an AI-driven support platform with an API for integrating and automating customer support.
auth_notes: Help Scout uses OAuth2 for authentication.
gate_detail: Free plan has no API access; need Standard, Plus, or Pro plan for API access.
blocker_detail: Need to create an OAuth2 app under Your Profile → My apps and then use the client ID and secret to get an access token.

evidence.quote_snippet: The Help Scout API authenticates with OAuth2: you exchange an app's client ID and secret for a two-day Bearer token and call https://api.helpscout.net/v2/
Help Scout's API rate limit is shared per account: up to 200 calls a minute on Standard, 400 on Plus and 800 on Pro, and the Free plan has no API access.
Your API Key Each User has a Docs API key. To generate, view, or regenerate the API key, click your avatar in the top right of your account, then click Your Profile.
MCP server for Help Scout - search conversations, customers, organizations, reports, and Docs with AI agents, plus opt-in writes for drafting replies and triage
